title: Python - Add Set Items
text:
Python -
Add Set Items



Add Items

Once a set is created, you cannot change its items, but you can add new items.

To add one item to a set use the
add()

method.

Add Sets

To add items from another set into the current set, use the
update()

method.

Add Any Iterable

The object in the
update()
method does not have
to be a set, it can be any iterable object (tuples, lists, dictionaries etc.).
